ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'Trigger_PTZ_UsunDomyslneTechnologieDlaZasobu' AND xtype = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.Trigger_PTZ_UsunDomyslneTechnologieDlaZasobu

CREATE TRIGGER CDN.Trigger_PTZ_UsunDomyslneTechnologieDlaZasobu ON CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby FOR DELETE AS BEGIN IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deleted d JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci c ON d.PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc = c.PTC_Id JOIN CDN.TwrKarty t ON d.PTZ_TwrNumer = t.Twr_GIDNumer AND d.PTZ_TwrTyp = t.Twr_GIDTyp JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci CI ON CI.PTC_Technologia = C.PTC_Technologia JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby ZI ON ZI.PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc = CI.PTC_Id AND ZI.PTZ_TypZasobu = 0 AND ZI.PTZ_TwrNumer = T.Twr_GIDNumer AND ZI.PTZ_TwrTyp = 16 AND ZI.PTZ_PodstawowaTechnologiaDlaProduktu = 1 WHERE c.PTC_Technologia = t.Twr_ProdTechnologia AND d.PTZ_TypZasobu = 0) = 0 BEGIN UPDATE TwrKarty SET Twr_ProdTechnologia = 0 WHERE Twr_GIDNumer IN (SELECT PTZ_TwrNumer FROM deleted) END END
